solutionSql:
SELECT s.customer_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.id)::integer AS shipments,
       SUM(i.amount) AS billed
FROM shipments s
LEFT JOIN invoices i ON i.shipment_id = s.id
GROUP BY s.customer_id
ORDER BY s.customer_id;
notes: The shipment count joins to invoices, so COUNT(DISTINCT shipment id) is needed to keep the count from being inflated, even though the sample has one invoice per shipment at most. The billed totals match c3-i1 for the six customers that have invoices.
